Tet’s Coffee

Roastery and café in Kohima. Beans roasted here, poured here.

Green

We roast in small batches in Kohima and serve the same coffee at our café counter, so what you drink is days old, not months.

The café

Easy pour in four steps

  1. 1
    Tear
    Tear open the sachet along the top.
  2. 2
    Set up
    Unfold the filter and hook it onto your cup.
  3. 3
    Bloom
    Pour a little hot water and let the coffee bloom for 20–30 seconds.
  4. 4
    Pour
    Slowly pour the remaining water in circles.
